name: Boon Gultor
saveBonusNote: Cloak of Protection +1, Ring of Protection +1, Stone of Good Luck +1
tools: Thieves' tools (expertise), Tinker's tools (expertise), Woodcarver's tools (expertise), artisan's tools
acNote: Scale mail +1 (16), +2 shield (+4), Cloak of Protection +1, Ring of Protection +1, Dex +2
saveNotes: Advantage on Con saves to keep concentration (War Caster); advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

elemental-weapon.name: Elemental Weapon
elemental-weapon.text: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder. The weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type when it hits. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Slot 5–6: +2 and 2d4; slot 7+: +3 and 3d4.

resources.name: Eldritch Cannon
resources.note: Or spend a spell slot to create one

actions.name: Create Eldritch Cannon
actions.text: Use woodcarver's or smith's tools to create a Small or Tiny cannon in an unoccupied space within 5 ft: Flamethrower, Force Ballista or Protector. It lasts 1 hour, until it drops to 0 HP, or until you dismiss it (action). Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot of level 1+.

actions.name: Cannon: Force Ballista
actions.text: Activate the cannon (bonus action, within 60 ft). Ranged spell attack, 120 ft. Hit: 3d8 Force and the target is pushed 5 ft away.

actions.name: Cannon: Flamethrower
actions.text: Activate the cannon: 15-ft Cone from the cannon. Dexterity save; 3d8 Fire on a failure, half on a success. Unattended flammable objects ignite.

actions.name: Cannon: Protector
actions.text: Activate the cannon: it and each creature you choose within 10 ft of it gain 1d8 + 5 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Cannon: Detonate
actions.text: Detonate the cannon (within 60 ft): 20-ft-radius Sphere, Dexterity save; 3d8 Force on a failure, half on a success. The cannon is destroyed.

actions.name: Flash of Genius
actions.text: When you or a creature within 30 ft makes an ability check or saving throw, add +5 (your Int modifier) to the roll.

actions.name: Stonecunning
actions.text: Gain Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes while on or touching natural or worked stone.

actions.name: Spell-Storing Item
actions.text: A creature holding the infused item casts the stored 1st- or 2nd-level artificer spell using your abilities.

actions.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
actions.text: Expend 1+ charges to cast Magic Missile (1 charge = level 1, +1 level per extra charge). Regains 1d6+1 charges at dawn.

traits.name: Creator
traits.text: Acts only when Boon activates it (bonus action within 60 ft). Uses Boon's spell attack (+9) and save DC (17). Regains 2d6 HP when Mending is cast on it.

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.text: Action with tools: give a Tiny nonmagical object light, an odor, a sound, a static image or a 6-second recorded message (up to Int mod objects).

features.name: Infuse Item
features.text: 8 infusions known, 4 infused items. Plans: +2 Wand of the War Mage, +2 Shield, Cloak of Protection, +1 Armor, Wand of Magic Detection, Manifold Tool.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.text: During a rest, spend 1 hour to create a set of artisan's tools.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.text: When you cast an artificer spell through your wand, add 1d8 to one of the spell's damage rolls.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.text: Your cannon's damage rolls increase by 1d8 (included); you can detonate it as an action.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.text: Double proficiency with all tools you're proficient with.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.text: Attune to up to 4 magic items; craft common and uncommon items in half the time and cost.

features.name: Spell Sniper
features.text: Your spells ignore half and three-quarters cover; casting within 5 ft of an enemy doesn't impose disadvantage; spells with a range of 10+ ft gain +60 ft.

features.name: War Caster
features.text: Advantage on Con saves to keep concentration; somatic components with hands full; cast a one-target action spell instead of an opportunity attack.

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.text: Resistance to Poison damage; advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

inventory: Backpack, bedroll, 2 flasks of oil, 10 days of rations, rope, 10 torches, tinderbox, waterskin
flags: Speed: your sheet says 60 ft. A 2024 dwarf has 30 ft and I found nothing on the sheet that doubles it. I kept 60; change it in Party if that's a typo.
Saves: the sheet's numbers leave out Cloak of Protection (+1), Ring of Protection (+1) and Stone of Good Luck (+1). I added all three, so his saves are 3 higher than the PDF.
Ability checks: Stone of Good Luck adds +1 to every check, which the sheet's skills leave out. Added.
Spell attack: the sheet shows +9, but the +2 Wand of the War Mage makes it +11 when he casts through it. I used +11 for his spells; the cannon keeps +9.
